description: This PHP source file defines the SaleShipping controller class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. The class handles reporting functionalities related to shipping for sales, including displaying reports, saving settings, and generating shipping data reports. It interacts with various models and views to produce the shipping-related report management interface and data.

classes.name: SaleShipping
classes.description: Controller class handling sale shipping reports in OpenCart's admin interface, providing functions for rendering report pages, saving settings, and generating report data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the sale shipping report form view with the necessary data and interface components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the saving of report settings, with permission validation, and returns a JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the shipping report page, including grouping options and report list.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the report list view, mainly for AJAX requests.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns the shipment report data as a view, supporting filtering, pagination, and localization.
